text.tspan: My project: CI builds once, GitOps deploys, EKS runs it, Prometheus watches it
Rollback = git revert the tag bump
AWS account per environment (Terraform-provisioned: VPC, EKS, RDS, IAM)
EKS: private subnets, managed node groups
Secrets Manager → External Secrets → K8s Secret
modules: vpc, eks, rds, iam · one state per env
plan on MR, apply after approval
